name: University of Wollongong in Dubai
englishBachelors: English-taught degrees in business, computing, engineering, media and social science.
note: Dubai Knowledge Park campus. The university uses January, April and September intakes; check which intake your degree offers.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: The 144-credit degree combines 90 credits of core study, 42 of electives and a 12-credit final-year group project. Start with programming, databases and networks before progressing to algorithms and software development. Advanced Entry takes three years; Direct Entry includes a Freshman Year.
programmes.ib: Published IB Diploma thresholds: 25 points for three-year Advanced Entry; 21 for four years with integrated Freshman Year. Confirm entry and availability for Autumn 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranking not published. IELTS Academic: 6.0 overall and in each skill for Advanced Entry; 5.0 overall for integrated Freshman Year.
notes: IELTS Academic: 6.0 overall and in each skill for Advanced Entry; 5.0 overall for integrated Freshman Year. The IB Diploma itself requires at least 24 points and other conditions; a 21-point result alone does not establish eligibility. Ask UOWD which credential it accepts. Published fee includes 5% VAT. It varies by study load and is not confirmed for 2027–28.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: A common engineering first year leads to mechanical design, thermodynamics and laboratory work. The four-year course includes a supervised thesis, professional experience and a mechanical engineering workshop; technical elective options include robotics and computational fluid dynamics.
programmes.ib: Four-year honours degree: 25 IB Diploma points. IELTS Academic 6.0 overall and in each skill. Ask the faculty about remedial entry; the 21-point route is not listed.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranking not published. After admission: Maths and Physics placement unless exempt (50% on each test; lower scores can require remedial classes).
notes: IELTS Academic: 6.0 overall and 6.0 in every skill. See the programme page for alternative English tests. After admission: Maths and Physics placement unless exempt (50% on each test; lower scores can require remedial classes). Published fee includes 5% VAT. It varies by study load and is not confirmed for 2027–28.

summary: English-taught bachelor’s degrees at Dubai Knowledge Park, with different entry routes for degrees with an integrated Freshman Year and for Engineering.
about: The UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation lists UOWD as active. Its undergraduate catalogue links to business, computer science, engineering, IT, media and design, and social science.

ib.text: Published IB Diploma minimums: 25 for three-year Advanced Entry, 21 with integrated Freshman Year where offered, and 25 for four-year Engineering. Course Results: ask UOWD to confirm.

notes: Autumn 2027 teaching starts 6 September; new-student orientation is 31 August–2 September. The academic calendar also lists Winter (4 January) and Spring (12 April). These are not application deadlines. Check programme and visa timing with UOWD; an Autumn 2027 application cutoff was not verified.

Full IB Diploma: UOWD’s current bachelor table lists 25 points for Advanced Entry (three years), or 21 for a degree with an integrated Freshman Year (four years) where available. The IB itself requires at least 24 points plus other conditions to award the Diploma. A 21-point result alone is not a Diploma. These are minimums, not guarantees. The central Engineering table lists 25 for its separate four-year degree.

IB Course Results: the UOWD counsellor table lists “IB Course” at 21 points for four-year Direct Entry, not three-year Advanced Entry. The table points to a 2025–26 guide; the current main admissions table and the IB statement do not confirm this pathway. Ask UOWD to confirm 2027 recognition for your subjects, your programme and school-leaving documents. Do not assume this is available for Engineering.

Apply online. Degree pages request secondary school records, proof of school completion, English test evidence and a passport copy. If you studied outside the UAE, check UOWD’s attestation instructions for foreign records before applying. Predicted-grade and final-document deadlines for Autumn 2027 were not verified.
English proof depends on the degree and entry route. Do not assume an IB English result substitutes for IELTS, TOEFL or PTE Academic. Use your programme’s table.
Current published fees are in AED, inclusive of 5% VAT, and vary with the subjects taken. No 2027–28 price was verified. Merit scholarship criteria and deadlines are separate from admission.

The Registry is a first stop for enrolled students seeking academic support, enrolment or careers guidance. UOWD names external student-housing providers; students arrange payment with the provider, not the university.

For budgeting, UOWD’s international student guide gives indicative figures of AED 3,000 per month for day-to-day spending and AED 27,000 per year for accommodation. These are general estimates, not housing offers or 2027 prices.

languageOfInstruction.note: UOWD states that its bachelor classes are taught in English.
